engineExpertQuestions.label: Target platform — desktop browser, mobile web, or both
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Mobile web changes recommendations for input handling, scale mode, audio unlock, and texture memory budget.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Multiplayer — none, local co-op, or online (WebSocket / WebRTC)
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Online multiplayer changes state synchronisation architecture significantly.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Physics backend — Arcade (default), Matter.js, or none
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Arcade physics is fast but axis-aligned only. Matter.js supports arbitrary polygon shapes and joints but has a higher CPU cost.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Save / persistence strategy — none, localStorage, IndexedDB, server-side
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Determines which storage API to wrap in the save system and whether offline play is supported.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Audio needs — none, simple SFX only, full music + SFX
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Full music + SFX on mobile web requires careful audio unlock and audio sprite bundling strategies.
